paragraphs: From Kilkenny O'Loughlin Gaels pull out of Lakeview Court and take the next right at the end of the road onto Hebron Road.
Continue up to the roundabout and take the 1st exit left onto Lintown Avenue.
Stay on Lintown Avenue for roughly half a kilometre until you reach the next roundabout.
At this roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Johnswell Road and follow it for about 350 metres.
Turn left into the Beechlawns estate.
In Beechlawns practice your reverse around a corner.
Practice a turnabout (three-point turn) in the estate.
Carry out a controlled stop, checking mirrors and blind spots carefully.
Make your way back out of Beechlawns and turn left onto Johnswell Road.
Continue for around 650 metres to the roundabout and go straight through, taking the exit slight left onto the Kilkenny Ring Road.
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Hebron Road.
Stay on Hebron Road through the following roundabout, 1st exit left.
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Castlecomer Road.
Turn right onto John's Green, which becomes Wolfe Tone Street.
Keep straight over Saint Francis Bridge and onto the Kilkenny Central Access Scheme Road.
Turn right onto Vicar Street and practice lane discipline, pedestrians and traffic lights.
From Vicar Street turn right onto Green Street, which becomes New Road.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Newpark Drive.
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Lintown Avenue.
Turn left to stay on Lintown Avenue, then turn right into Lakeview Court to complete the main loop.
Come back out to Hebron Road with a right at the end of the road.
Take the roundabout 1st exit left, then the next roundabout 1st exit left onto Castlecomer Road.
Take a final right onto John Street Upper to return near Carr's Lane and back toward the O'Loughlin Gaels test centre.
